notesForReviewer: Exactly 20 manifest entries were inspected, selected as the next 20 in the manifest's original array order following the 30 already handled by Batches 1 and 2.

15 of the 20 were classified ALREADY_FIXED, all with their effective override already living in dossier-overrides-45.js -- every one already supersedes the contaminated base shelfcheck-dossiers.txt entry at runtime, so Josh has never seen the wrong text for any of these 15. Each was independently re-verified against the real game for accuracy and deliberately left untouched.

5 of the 20 were classified REPAIRED (genuinely LIVE_CONTAMINATED): no override existed, so the contaminated base text was what ShelfCheck actually served. New, game-specific overrides for these 5 were added in a new file, dossier-overrides-48.js, following the exact same {t,s,w,c,r,b,p} object-literal schema as every prior batch.

Firefighters: Airport Fire Department's dossier text honestly notes the same studio/genre lineage as the already-excluded Firefighters: The Simulation (GENERIC_SIM, curation pass #1) -- this repair only touched dossier content, not census status; Firefighters: Airport Fire Department itself remains INCLUDED and was not re-evaluated for exclusion (out of scope for this pass).

Flipping Death's curator take draws an evidence-supported connection to the Josh-confirmed hit Stick it to the Man! (same studio, same art style/humor/mechanic lineage per multiple reviews) while being explicit that this specific personal-fit claim is not confirmed for this title, avoiding manufactured personalization.

dossier-apply.js, index.html, and sw.js each received exactly one minimal line-edit to register/precache the new batch file, consistent with every prior batch; sw.js's cache generation was bumped shelfcheck-v137 -> shelfcheck-v138.
